accepted.sentence: Before positioning it, users often measure the wall and nearby clearance to keep doors, windows, and walkways unobstructed.
Frequently consulted titles are often placed near eye level, while less-used references occupy higher or lower positions.
Library staff may assign call-number ranges to sections, then return each volume to its corresponding position after use.
Users can wipe fingerprints from smooth outer panels with a soft cloth, avoiding abrasive cleaners that may scratch finishes.
To reduce fading from window light, people may move exposed volumes to a shaded spot or rotate their arrangement.
In humid rooms, ventilation and distance from damp walls help limit moisture damage to stored paper and wooden panels.
For added stability, users may fasten anti-tip hardware into a wall stud to reduce the risk of forward tipping.
Before relocating it, people usually empty the compartments and carry the frame upright to reduce strain on its joints.
